description: This file defines the MyTimesheetAPI class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin, extending EmployeeTimesheetAPI to handle API validation rules for timesheet-related operations, including custom validation logic for dates and authorization.

classes.name: MyTimesheetAPI
classes.description: A class extending EmployeeTimesheetAPI that manages validation rules for timesheet API endpoints, with custom validation for dates.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the employee number of the authenticated user.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for retrieving all timesheets, removing the employee number parameter from parent rules.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for creating a timesheet entry, customizing date validation with TimesheetDateRule.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a timesheet, removing the employee number parameter.
